# nestjs-smart-modules

> A lightweight, type-safe library that simplifies NestJS module configuration: services become composable smart modules, configuration merges across the dependency tree into a single typed object provided at the application root. Zero runtime dependencies; dual CJS/ESM builds; peer NestJS ^8 || ^9 || ^10 || ^11.

Key semantics: every smart module factory call creates its own DynamicModule (own provider instances per importing branch); the merged configuration is delivered identically to all of them. Async configuration follows the registerAsync convention (imports/inject/useFactory) and resolves inject from non-global modules.

- [README](https://github.com/webwayer/nestjs-smart-modules/blob/main/README.md): quick start, labels/prefixes/tokens, composition, async configuration, factory pattern, recipes, instance semantics
- [API Reference](https://webwayer.github.io/nestjs-smart-modules/): generated TypeDoc for the public API
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/webwayer/nestjs-smart-modules/blob/main/README.md#compatibility): NestJS and Node support matrix
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/webwayer/nestjs-smart-modules/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Testing conventions](https://github.com/webwayer/nestjs-smart-modules/blob/main/spec/TESTING.md)
- [NestJS 12 readiness checklist](https://github.com/webwayer/nestjs-smart-modules/issues/2)
